basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast who recently got into gaming, especially with an interest in games like Grim Dawn. Based in Seattle, I work in tech support which gives me a fair amount of time to explore my hobbies online. My interests include video games, particularly RPGs, and learning about different cultures, which explains my recent dive into Japanese gaming. I'm single and usually online in the evenings after work. I dislike overly complex tech jargon and prefer straightforward solutions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in IT support, which has provided me with a solid understanding of operating systems and troubleshooting software issues. My gaming knowledge is growing, primarily self-taught through online forums and community discussions.
